sentences.en: I want to have a full and enriching student-life.
sentences.zh: 我想拥有一个充实而丰富的学生生活。

sentences.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
sentences.zh: 与她的相遇丰富了他的内心世界。

sentences.en: The Anglo-Saxons enriched the language by borrowing words from other languages.
sentences.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人通过从其他语言借词丰富了语言。

senses.zh: 使充实，使丰富；使富裕，使富有；使（土壤）肥沃；浓缩（核燃料中的原子）
